messages:
maria: Heads-up — we just started seeing a higher-than-normal rate of structured output rejections in prod (model: rdlw-2b, route: /chat/generate). ~0.8% -> 3.5% over the last hour :eyes:
kevin: ugh. any obvious schema change?
ash: (ops-bot) alert created: SVC-REJ-3287 — aggregated failures by schema_error_code.
maria: digging now. initial query shows most failures are 'missing_required_property' for `action.items` — but callers *think* they send arrays.
kevin: could be a nested serialization mismatch (stringified JSON vs actual array). We saw similar with third-party connectors last quarter.
tian: Is the runtime rejecting earlier (strict validation) or are these post-hoc console checks? important for mitigation strategy.
maria: these are runtime responses: we return 400 with `structured_output_error` payload. sample: ```json
{"error":"structured_output_error","details":{"code":"missing_required_property","path":"/output/action/items","expected":"array","received":"string"}}
```
ash: ops-bot: we've routed 12% of these events to fallback_model (rdlw-1b-safe) automatically. fallback success rate ~92%.
kevin: fallback is helpful short-term, but it skews latency and cost. We need to decide whether to: (A) relax schema enforcement to soft-warning + telemetry, or (B) keep hard rejects and force caller fixes.
maria: product asked for hard rejects to avoid silent data corruption. but we could add a short-term compatibility toggle per-route in the console.
tian: telemetry side: current rejection events only emit aggregated counts and last_error_sample. We should enrich with `caller_id`, `payload_signature`, `model_variant`, `route_config_snapshot` so support can triage without asking for logs.\eash?ash: +1 on richer telemetry, but watch PII. we must strip any user content before shipping. maybe add `payload_schema_hash` and a stable `prompt_signature` instead of raw input.
kevin: UX: console should surface a single-line quick action: "Temporarily accept coercible payloads" and a link to view failure samples. Also show projected cost delta if fallback is used.
console-team: can build a card. questions: do we have an API flag? right now runtime respects `enforce_structured_schema: true|false` at route-level config. toggling it will immediately stop rejecting and instead attach `schema_warnings` in metadata.
maria: exactly. proposal: default remains strict=true. Add a new quick toggle that sets strict->false for up to 24h and creates an audit entry + rollout canary (only 5% of traffic).
tian: telemetry events needed for this flow: `schema_reject` (hard reject), `schema_warning` (soft accept), `fallback_routed`, `fallback_result_quality` with token_cost. example event fields: ```
{
  "event":"schema_reject",
  "route":"/chat/generate",
  "schema_code":"missing_required_property",
  "schema_path":"/output/action/items",
  "caller_id":"team-abc",
  "model_variant":"rdlw-2b-v3",
  "payload_schema_hash":"sha256:...",
  "sample":false
}
```
kevin: also add sampling rules so we don't send entire payloads. store a pointer to s3+kms with TTL for support when authorized.
ash: ops-bot: created ticket INF-1221 to add telemetry fields + sampling.
maria: blocker: console UX for toggle + canary + projected costs. product wants a mock by EOD. can someone sketch a minimal flow?
console-team: I'll mock. flow: 1) click "Schema rejects rising" banner -> open modal showing samples + suggested fix; 2) toggle "soft accept (24h)" with slider for % traffic (default 5%); 3) confirm -> system creates audit log + canary policy in routing service; 4) telemetry updates flagged as `schema_warning`.
kevin: add tiny keyboard shortcut: `g` then `s` to open the modal :P
tian: operational concerns: when we soft-accept, downstream tooling (logging, downstream indexing) must handle variant shapes. ensure we label outputs with `schema_accept_level: soft|hard`.
maria: QA checklist: - ensure config propagation across regions (<30s) - ensure canary obeys quota and rate limits - ensure sampled payloads are redacted
ash: assigned to infra: @ash for rollout plumbing, @tian for telemetry schema, @console-team for UI mock.
ash: ops-bot: new assignment: INF-1221 -> assignees: ash,tian,console-team. due: 3d.
ash: tiny note: let's add a small metric in the per-route dashboard: 1h reject rate, 24h trend, fallback cost impact. product suggested color-coded severity bands.
maria: thanks — I'll sync with product after mock. anyone else? :thumbsup:
kevin: quick experiment idea: try a lightweight auto-coercion step in the runtime for common issues (string->array if it looks parseable). track coerced_as_warning. might reduce breakage w/out manual fixes.	ian: fine if it's opt-in per-route. but log it as `coercion_applied=true` and sample original.
console-team: noted. I'll include an extra toggle "allow auto-coercion" with explanation and risk note.
maria: excellent. we should also add a short KB article for integrators explaining common causes (JSON-encoding, escaped strings). I'll draft it and drop in #docs.
kevin: great. moving to implement.
ops-bot: deploy pipeline kicked for INF-1221 branch.```
